title: Version LoomDatasetArtifact v1
problem: The current downloadable manifest is a compile receipt rather than a portable data artifact contract
change: Define manifest schema provenance quality README and primary-data invariants under one versioned artifact identity
acceptance: A literal artifact fixture validates every required file digest identity and cross-file invariant
observed_verification: Current backlog names data plus feature meanings but no versioned artifact exists
migration: Artifact v1 is new and does not reinterpret existing receipts

title: Add hostile multi-related FHIR fixture
problem: The fast fixture does not force two related records for one root or the important missingness and FHIR-shape cases
change: Add two Observations for one Patient plus repeated choice coding all-null partial and missing-reference cases
acceptance: Fixture load produces literal expected identities cardinalities and values without changing the existing smoke case
observed_verification: The existing backlog explicitly says the current fixture cannot prove multiplicity safety
migration: Keep existing fixture IDs stable and add a separately named product fixture

title: Add product acceptance feature map
problem: The local driver proves the mechanical flow but does not identify product-semantic scenarios or retained artifacts
change: Add named acceptance scenarios and literal evidence fields for row grain multiplicity projection quality and export identity
acceptance: The driver report distinguishes each product scenario and fails when a required semantic assertion is absent
observed_verification: verify-fast and verify-full already share the driver entry point
migration: Preserve existing command names and report fields while adding versioned scenario evidence

title: Create artifact golden fixtures
problem: There is no literal cross-file oracle for data schema provenance quality and human documentation
change: Add small deterministic artifact fixtures and validate digests row counts column order and identifiers
acceptance: A one-row artifact and hostile multi-row artifact validate byte-stable sidecar semantics apart from declared volatile fields
observed_verification: No artifact fixture exists today
migration: Golden artifacts carry their artifactVersion and are replaced only by an explicit version migration

title: Record product-loop performance baselines
problem: Future vertical slices need comparable latency memory and artifact-size evidence without turning one run into a guarantee
change: Record repeated warm fixture load reconcile preview publish Viewer and export timings plus retained bytes
acceptance: Five warm runs report median and max with environment and exact commit; later packages investigate repeated regression above ten percent
observed_verification: The existing architecture loop already records edit-to-observed timing but not product-stage timings
migration: Performance evidence is observational and does not alter runtime contracts

title: Carry observed relationship cardinality into capability
problem: Field repetition metadata does not prove whether a related route has zero one or many target resources per root
change: Expose bounded observed zero one many counts and evidence scope for each relationship occurrence
acceptance: The two-Observation fixture advertises many for the affected route and one or zero for the literal control rows
observed_verification: Source review found route compilation independent of relationship multiplicity
migration: Version capability metadata and treat unknown cardinality as unknown rather than one

title: Model row grain and row key explicitly
problem: Row grain is displayed after compilation but not authored and row-key safety is not part of the user decision
change: Add a typed row-grain declaration and row-key evidence to authoring receipt and output contract
acceptance: Builder states one row per selected root and reports null or duplicate row-key evidence before publication
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/...; cd ui && npm test -- DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: The contract panel currently renders a row-grain label and booleans only
migration: Migrate legacy drafts to an explicit legacy inferred row-grain state and require confirmation before republish

title: Define route-level repetition policy
problem: A route can be one-to-many without an authored decision about aggregation arrays indexing first or separate output
change: Add a closed RepetitionPolicy type owned by the authoring domain and carried by commands receipts and compiler input
acceptance: Illegal combinations cannot be represented and every one-to-many route has an explicit policy before compile
observed_verification: The current command vocabulary has route addition but no route cardinality policy
migration: Version commands and receipts; legacy implicit behavior remains readable but cannot claim ready

title: Reject silent scalar collapse
problem: A scalar field path can still collapse multiple related resources through FIRST and be described as lossless
change: Reject ambiguous scalar compilation or mark explicit FIRST as lossy using relationship evidence
acceptance: The hostile fixture cannot publish a supposedly lossless scalar that drops one Observation
observed_verification: The existing compiler supports projection modes but source review found no relationship-multiplicity proof
migration: Existing ambiguous receipts become legacy unsafe and require explicit re-authoring before publish

title: Publish stable cardinality reason codes
problem: Lossless and ML-ready booleans do not explain which rows or relationship caused an unsafe result
change: Add stable reason codes evidence counts and plain-language remediation to the contract
acceptance: API and UI report the same code affected-root count and next action for the multi-related route
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/server; cd ui && npm test -- DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: The current panel renders Yes or No and a lossy suffix without causal evidence
migration: Old clients may ignore reasons but must not convert unknown into ready

title: Explain route risk before adding fields
problem: The graph exposes legal relationships but not the consequence of adding a many-valued child to the row grain
change: Show observed cardinality and a researcher-language explanation in graph and route extension surfaces
acceptance: A user sees that some Patients have multiple Observations and must choose a representation before selecting values
verification_command: cd ui && npm test -- GuidedGraphWorkspace RouteExtensionPanel
observed_verification: Current graph tests cover layout and route interaction rather than cardinality meaning
migration: Unknown evidence displays as unknown and never as safe

title: Prove row-policy DOM flow
problem: Unit contracts do not prove a nontechnical user is prevented from publishing silent loss
change: Extend the warm browser scenario from route selection through policy choice receipt preview and publish
acceptance: Without a policy publish is disabled with actionable copy; after a policy the exact expected values and warning state appear
observed_verification: The backlog already defines the two-Observation live acceptance case
migration: Retain the existing smoke path and add the hostile scenario by name

title: Expose projection choices in ColumnSelector
problem: ColumnSelector always applies the candidate default even when multiple projection modes are advertised
change: Render only supported modes with plain-language consequences and an intentional default
acceptance: The hostile repeated candidate offers safe available choices and the selected mode is visible before add
observed_verification: Source inspection confirms defaultProjectionMode is submitted directly
migration: Legacy columns display their stored mode and unknown modes fail visibly

title: Allow projection changes on configured columns
problem: A user must delete and recreate a column because UPDATE_COLUMN does not own source projection changes
change: Add an intentional versioned source-policy update command with digest and capability checks
acceptance: Changing ALL to INDEXED persists once survives reload and produces the new literal shape
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/authoringv2/...; cd ui && npm test -- authoring
observed_verification: Current ADD_COLUMN owns source while UPDATE_COLUMN is presentation oriented
migration: Migrate callers to the new command and delete any temporary dual-write path in the same wave

title: Specify deterministic FIRST ordering
problem: FIRST is lossy and its selected record is not a clinically meaningful or user-visible ordering rule
change: Require an explicit supported ordering or expose the deterministic technical ordering as a warning
acceptance: Two identical runs select the same value and receipt/schema name the ordering and loss
observed_verification: FIRST exists as a projection mode but its related-record meaning is not user-authored
migration: Legacy FIRST is labeled legacy technical order and requires confirmation before republish

title: Specify INDEXED width and overflow
problem: Indexed output needs stable ordering width and overflow behavior to avoid unnoticed schema drift or truncation
change: Make width ordering and overflow reject-or-warn policy part of the authored projection
acceptance: Adding a third value to width two either blocks or reports exact overflow and never silently disappears
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/compilation/...; cd ui && npm test -- ColumnSelector
observed_verification: Current types expose INDEXED without a complete user-facing width contract
migration: Persist width policy with the column source and require migration for legacy indexed columns

title: Keep array and distinct semantics consistent
problem: ALL and DISTINCT may be rendered or exported like scalar text unless every surface consumes the declared array shape
change: Define shared array ordering duplicate and null semantics from receipt through Viewer and artifact schema
acceptance: ALL retains duplicates in deterministic order; DISTINCT removes duplicates with stated order; neither is labeled scalar
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/...; cd ui && npm test -- ColumnSelector PreviewTable ExplorerViewer
observed_verification: The shared types contain the modes but the current UI does not author them
migration: Version array encoding in the runtime contract and keep raw arrays out of ambiguous comma-joined text

title: Prove projection parity across surfaces
problem: Focused compiler or UI tests alone can miss disagreements among receipt preview Viewer and export
change: Add one live matrix for supported projections with literal values shapes warnings and schema
acceptance: Every mode selected in Builder has matching receipt Preview Viewer and exported representation
observed_verification: The backlog calls for Preview and contract agreement but no complete projection matrix exists
migration: Store fixture expectations by artifactVersion and projection policy

title: Define typed derived-feature source union
problem: Lower layers support aggregates but the guided authoring boundary is field-selection oriented
change: Add a closed derived-feature source union for count filtered-count and exists with stable semantic operands
acceptance: Invalid operator selector and filter combinations cannot be constructed or persisted
observed_verification: The command vocabulary exposes ADD_COLUMN but not a dedicated feature source workflow
migration: Version column sources and migrate every authoring caller in the same wave

title: Compile Observation count and existence
problem: A frontend feature is useless unless its semantic source lowers to the existing aggregate engine with the declared type and cardinality
change: Lower count and exists through one compiler-owned path and derive schema from the same result
acceptance: Hostile fixture count and existence have exact integer and boolean values with matching schema
observed_verification: Source review found aggregate lowering vocabulary below the UI
migration: New source variants are versioned and old field sources remain unchanged

title: Compile filtered count with explicit predicate
problem: Researchers need clinically meaningful subsets such as final Observations rather than only raw related-record counts
change: Support one bounded equality/existence predicate vocabulary and reject unsupported filters at authoring
acceptance: Final-only count differs from total count exactly as the fixture specifies and unsupported predicates fail before persistence
observed_verification: Existing rich-filter support is narrower than the general filter vocabulary
migration: Start with an explicit version-one predicate subset and do not accept operators the compiler cannot preserve

title: Build guided derived-feature panel
problem: The only visible authoring path selects raw candidates and assumes users understand paths
change: Add a focused feature panel that asks what to count or test and offers supported predicates in plain language
acceptance: A user creates total and final-only Observation counts without entering a recipe path selector or AQL
observed_verification: ColumnSelector currently submits one field candidate and its default projection
migration: Keep raw-field authoring and derived features as explicit sibling flows

title: Show derivation and missing meaning
problem: A numeric feature without derivation and null semantics is not reusable training metadata
change: Render a safe semantic expression feature type and missing-value meaning in receipt and contract views
acceptance: The count column says what was counted which filter applied and whether absence becomes zero or null
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/...; cd ui && npm test -- DerivedFeature DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: Current contract lineage is path oriented and does not expose guided derivation meaning
migration: Add versioned descriptor fields; never infer missing meaning from displayed values

title: Prove derived-feature value parity
problem: Backend vocabulary and frontend controls can drift while individual tests remain green
change: Drive authoring receipt preview publication Viewer and exported rows for total count filtered count and exists
acceptance: Each surface returns the literal fixture values and stable logical types under one receipt
observed_verification: The backlog requires exact count in Viewer and CSV but no current UI path authors it
migration: Pin expected values to the hostile fixture and artifact version

title: Bind profiling to immutable preview identity
problem: Quality queries can lie if they resolve a different draft publication or materialization from the rows being previewed
change: Add a receipt/materialization-bound profile request and response identity
acceptance: Rows and quality share receipt generation output and materialization IDs; mismatches fail closed
observed_verification: Preview and publish already use receipts but no quality profile contract exists
migration: Version the profile response and reject current-pointer-only quality reads

title: Measure row-key integrity
problem: One row per root is not trustworthy without null and duplicate row-key measurements
change: Compute total null and duplicate row-key counts on the pinned output and block readiness when the declared invariant fails
acceptance: The hostile fixture control reports zero violations and an injected duplicate reports a stable blocking reason
verification_command: go test ./internal/dataframe/published/... ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/...; cd ui && npm test -- DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: Current panel reports row grain but no measured key integrity
migration: Add reason codes and metrics without changing existing row values

title: Measure coverage and missingness
problem: Null cells are visible but the user cannot distinguish useful sparse features from all-null output
change: Report populated missing empty and invalid counts plus rates for every selected feature
acceptance: Partial and all-null fixture columns show exact counts and actionable ready-with-warning or blocked states
verification_command: go test ./internal/dataframe/published/... ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/...; cd ui && npm test -- PreviewTable DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: The backlog identifies missing feature-level coverage
migration: Use explicit unknown when a missingness reason cannot be measured

title: Measure cardinality and distributions
problem: A researcher cannot judge categorical explosion numeric range or near-constant features from sample cells
change: Reuse bounded type-appropriate aggregation paths for distinct counts ranges and compact distributions
acceptance: Numeric and categorical fixture features have literal summaries with explicit sampling or limit metadata
observed_verification: GraphQL exposes aggregation inputs but Builder does not consume training-oriented profiles
migration: Version summary methods and state truncation or sampling explicitly

title: Measure relationship loss and overflow
problem: Readiness must reflect how many root rows were collapsed truncated overflowed or expanded by relationship policy
change: Carry zero one many and affected-root metrics into the pinned quality report
acceptance: FIRST INDEXED and array policies report exact affected counts and no supposedly lossless output hides dropped values
observed_verification: Compiler contract fields currently lack observed relationship-loss counts
migration: Metrics are added to the quality version and legacy unknown remains a warning

title: Define evidence-backed readiness states
problem: A single ML-ready boolean hides incompatible reasons and cannot guide remediation
change: Define ready ready_with_warnings and blocked from stable measured reason records rather than scattered UI conditions
acceptance: Every hostile condition maps to a literal state code evidence and suggested next action; unknown never becomes ready
verification_command: go test ./internal/explorer/... ./internal/dataframe/published/...; cd ui && npm test -- DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: Current panel renders an ML-ready boolean
migration: Version readiness and treat legacy boolean-only payloads as unknown

title: Show cohort and filter effects
problem: Coverage can change materially after a cohort filter but the product does not compare before and after populations
change: Report row and feature coverage deltas for the authored cohort/filter context under the same pin
acceptance: Applying the fixture filter shows exact before and after rows and feature coverage without mixing identities
verification_command: go test ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/...; cd ui && npm test -- PreviewTable DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: Current Viewer supports filters while Builder quality does not surface cohort effects
migration: Record the applied filter digest in profile and artifact provenance

title: Define canonical semantic column descriptor
problem: Builder Preview Viewer and export assemble column meaning from different partial fields
change: Define one versioned descriptor with stable key label type shape role source relationship path choice code projection derivation and missing meaning
acceptance: The same literal descriptor is decoded and rendered by every UI surface and artifact schema
verification_command: go test ./internal/fhir/schema/...; cd ui && npm test -- semantic ExplorerViewer
observed_verification: Current runtime types include provenance fields but no complete shared product descriptor
migration: Parse external legacy descriptors once at the API boundary and delete duplicate internal shapes

title: Explain FHIR choices codes and relationships
problem: Choice arms code systems repeated coordinates and relationship occurrences are expert-only metadata or absent from the primary experience
change: Add friendly explanations with exact advanced details from the canonical descriptor
acceptance: Repeated choice and coding fixture columns show human meaning and exact resource path arm system and relationship occurrence
verification_command: go test ./internal/fhir/schema/...; cd ui && npm test -- semantic ExplorerViewer ColumnSelector
observed_verification: Current types carry some provenance but visible controls focus on candidate labels
migration: Keep stable paths and keys; explanation text is versioned separately from identity

title: Share null empty and array rendering policy
problem: Different surfaces can turn null empty arrays nested values and invalid values into inconsistent or ambiguous text
change: Centralize semantic display tokens and structured array rendering without comma-joining ambiguity
acceptance: Builder Preview Viewer details and CSV/README explanations distinguish absent null empty invalid and list values
verification_command: cd ui && npm test -- semantic PreviewTable ExplorerViewer
observed_verification: Viewer currently owns its own textFor conversion
migration: Migrate UI callers in one wave and preserve machine values separately from display text

title: Record feature role and leakage intent
problem: A technically valid feature can leak outcomes when role index time and observation window are not recorded
change: Add identifier feature label metadata ignore roles plus optional index-time and observation-window intent with evidence warnings
acceptance: A label recorded after index time produces a visible warning and artifact metadata; Loom does not silently decide clinical safety
verification_command: go test ./internal/fhir/schema/...; cd ui && npm test -- semantic DataframeContractPanel
observed_verification: Current contract has ML-ready but no role or temporal intent
migration: Legacy columns default to unspecified role and warning rather than inferred feature

title: Prove semantic continuity after reload
problem: Semantic metadata is useful only if it survives publish Builder Viewer switching and reload
change: Extend the live flow to compare the canonical descriptor and displayed meaning before and after reload
acceptance: Row grain projection role null meaning and publication identity remain identical across Builder Viewer and reload
observed_verification: Current loop checks reload mechanically but not semantic continuity
migration: Pin expectations to descriptorVersion and artifactVersion

title: Prove or replace the public export seam
problem: A server streaming exporter exists but no confirmed frontend-reachable public route or caller was found
change: Reproduce a supported public caller; connect the existing service if its boundary is correct or replace it with one explicit artifact export operation
acceptance: A real authorized HTTP or GraphQL request streams fixture data and cancellation without internal invocation
observed_verification: GitNexus and source inspection found the method but no public caller; implementation is gated on reproduction
migration: Do not expose or delete the method until route ownership is proven

title: Bind export to immutable publication identity
problem: Browser export pages the logical current selector and a republish can change the resolved materialization
change: Start export with one authorized publication revision and materialization pin used for every row and sidecar query
acceptance: Publishing revision B during revision A export cannot change any data identity or digest in the artifact
observed_verification: Current UI export loops over pages and server reads resolve project data without an explicit artifact pin
migration: Version selectors/cursors and reject stale or mismatched pins explicitly

title: Stream bounded compatibility formats
problem: The browser accumulates all rows before producing CSV and cannot safely export large training tables
change: Expose server-streamed CSV and JSONL with cancellation byte/time limits and explicit incomplete failure
acceptance: Multi-page export keeps browser memory bounded and a midstream failure never appears as a completed download
verification_command: go test ./internal/api/graphql/graph/dataframe/... ./internal/dataframe/published/...; cd ui && npm test -- Viewer
observed_verification: The service can stream CSV TSV JSON and JSONL internally while the UI builds a Blob
migration: Keep existing small CSV behavior only as a temporary caller migration and remove it in the same wave

title: Add Parquet artifact data format
problem: CSV loses nested types and is inefficient for ML training pipelines
change: Add a server-side Parquet writer that preserves logical types nullability arrays and stable column order
acceptance: Parquet schema and literal values match schema.json and the same pinned rows as CSV
observed_verification: Existing exporter supports text formats only
migration: Advertise supported formats explicitly; artifact v1 may ship CSV first only if P0 records that decision

title: Assemble checksummed artifact archive
problem: Data downloads lack the schema provenance quality and human meaning needed for reproducible training
change: Generate manifest schema provenance quality README and data under one content-addressed archive
acceptance: Every manifest digest verifies and every sidecar identifies the same publication materialization row count and columns
observed_verification: The backlog calls for a manifest but no archive assembler exists
migration: Artifact format is independently versioned and immutable once emitted

title: Add export progress cancel and failure UX
problem: A large browser Blob offers weak progress and failure semantics and can leave users unsure whether a file is complete
change: Add an artifact export job/download flow with visible pin format progress cancellation retry and actionable errors
acceptance: Cancel and injected failure produce no completed artifact; retry remains pinned or explicitly starts a new identity
verification_command: cd ui && npm test -- Viewer ExplorerViewer; make verify-fast
observed_verification: Viewer currently exposes a generic CSV download path
migration: Remove the browser pagination exporter after all callers use the server artifact flow

title: Prove republish and failure safety live
problem: Static contracts do not prove a multi-page export stays on one snapshot or rejects a partial stream
change: Add live scenarios that publish B during A export and inject a later-page failure
acceptance: The completed archive is wholly A with verified digests; the failed attempt is visibly incomplete and not offered as a final file
observed_verification: The republish risk is inferred from current selector pagination and requires an executable proof
migration: Use product-fixture identities and retain failure evidence without production mutation
